## Vireo v0.14.4

Cleaner Source Control sidebar when the working tree has no pending changes.

### UI & Source Control

- **Removed redundant clean-state banners.** The Source Control pane no longer renders the "Up to date" branch status line when already in sync with the remote, or the "Working tree clean" empty-state card when there are no uncommitted changes. Actionable branch statuses (ahead/behind, diverged, unpublished, detached, blocked, or gone upstream) still appear as before, and the commit graph now expands into the full space automatically when the working tree is clean (`7019f95`).

### Installing on macOS

The macOS build is not notarized, so the first launch of a downloaded copy needs one extra step: open Vireo once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vireo.app` in Terminal.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.14.3...v0.14.4
